title: Early Tamil Pottery AI - Reference Verification Record
description: One check of ONE claim against ONE reference by ONE human, at one time (Milestone 8). APPEND-ONLY: a later check is a new record that supersedes the earlier one; nothing is overwritten. A reference counts as verified only for the claims a human actually checked in the physical or authorised publication. A citation existing online is not verification. Rules V1-V8: src/knowledge/verification.py.

citation.description: Bibliographic citation as checked (snapshot of the knowledge-base citation, corrected by the verifier if the publication differs).

claim.description: The specific statement checked, in words.

claim_id.description: Knowledge-base claim id (see `python -m src.knowledge claims`), or 'not_applicable' for a claim not in the knowledge base.

status.description: verified_against_source = the claim was found as stated in the publication. discrepancy_found = the publication says something different (see notes); the claim must not be used. source_unavailable = the publication could not be consulted; the claim stays unverified. unverified = recorded for tracking only; nothing was checked.

verifier.description: Stable id of the HUMAN who checked, or 'not_applicable' when nothing was checked.

verifier_role.description: There is deliberately no AI option: software cannot verify a reference.

locator.description: Page, plate, figure or catalogue number where the claim appears, exactly as found. 'not_available' only when nothing was checked.

source_location.description: Where the copy consulted is held (library and shelfmark, institutional repository, the publisher's open-access URL).

source_access.description: How the publication was consulted. Unauthorised copies are not an acceptable basis (docs/DATA_SOURCE_AUDIT.md).
